solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Superior unions collectively back strike

parts.note: upper means higher in rank or position

indicators.note: back tells us the letters for the union body are read in reverse order

parts.note: the TUC, Trades Union Congress, is the federation of British trade unions

explanation.surface: A union boss urges members to back a walkout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strike' looks like industrial action alongside the unions, but it is a punch.
explanation.definitionFit: An uppercut is an upward punch, a kind of blow delivered by a boxer.

clue.text: Sends rude novel — with such illustrations?

definitions.text: Sends rude novel — with such illustrations?

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Someone posts off a racy book, illustrations and all.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: a rude novel might well come with naked pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Undressed means naked, the state of figures in risqué illustrations.

clue.text: University in lead is first in Hungary to pen large issue

indicators.note: to pen means to enclose, so the built letters surround the large letter
in means the university letter sits inside the lead symbol

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
taken as written

indicators.note: first in takes the opening letter of the country

parts.note: the source of one initial letter

explanation.surface: A university leads Hungary in printing large editions.
explanation.definitionFit: To issue a book or statement is to make it public, release it.

clue.text: Regret hosting thousands on king's vessel

indicators.note: hosting means the regret word holds the thousands inside

parts.note: to rue is to regret
M is a thousand, so MM is thousands
R, for rex, is the Latin abbreviation for king; the 's here means 'is'

explanation.surface: A monarch regrets hosting thousands on his ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship; a rummer is a large drinking glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A rummer is a large stemmed drinking glass, a vessel for drink.

clue.text: A foreign action keeps police in two minds

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: keeps means the action word holds the police letters

parts.note: a deed is an action
the CID, Criminal Investigation Department, is the British detective branch

explanation.surface: Overseas legal action keeps the police wavering.
explanation.definitionFit: To be undecided is to be uncertain, torn between two options.

clue.text: A father secures power to rise to a great height

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: secures here means holds within, so the father word is wrapped round the power letter

parts.note: to sire is to father, and a sire is a father

explanation.surface: A dad backs his offspring's ambitions to climb high.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire is literally to soar up, an older sense beside the usual one of ambition.

clue.text: Possibly infinite series of language lessons

indicators.note: series of means a run of consecutive letters is taken from the following words

parts.note: taken as written, where the answer runs on

explanation.surface: An endless course of language classes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ageless never grows old, so it may last for ever.

clue.text: Look round a course? Not in this!

definitions.text: Look round a course? Not in this!

indicators.note: round means the look word goes around the rest

parts.note: to peer is to look closely
taken as written
soup is a course of a meal

explanation.surface: A golfer can't look round the course in thick fog.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: in a thick fog you cannot see round a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A pea-souper is a dense yellowish London fog, thick as pea soup.

clue.text: Soak with Asian money the result of error in court?

definitions.text: the result of error in court?

parts.note: to ret is to soak flax or hemp to soften it
the rial is the currency of Iran and Oman

explanation.surface: A drunk with foreign cash makes a mistake in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soak' suggests a drunkard; it is the flax-processing verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A retrial is a second trial, often ordered when a legal error tainted the first.

clue.text: Knight's half of republic's capital

indicators.note: half of tells us only the first three of the city's six letters are kept

parts.note: Dublin is the capital of the Republic of Ireland

explanation.surface: A knight claims a share of an Irish city.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: To dub someone is to confer knighthood by tapping the shoulders with a sword.

clue.text: Part of the world suggesting it's Anglo-Saxon?

definitions.meaning: the straight reading: a region of the globe
the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms included the Middle Saxons and the East Saxons, so the two-word name sounds like their territory

explanation.walkthrough: Middlesex and Essex take their names from the Middle and East Saxons, so the region's name reads like a pair of Anglo-Saxon labels.
explanation.definitionFit: The region spanning southwest Asia and Egypt is the familiar geopolitical area named here.

clue.text: Need to leave almost leaderless business

indicators.note: almost means the word for leaving loses its final letter

parts.note: exit means to leave or go out

indicators.note: leaderless means the firm word loses its opening letter

parts.note: an agency is a business providing a service

explanation.surface: A firm without a boss needs to quit, nearly.
explanation.definitionFit: An exigency is an urgent requirement or pressing demand.

clue.text: Colourful English Times involved in hearing

parts.note: the multiplication sign is an X
otic means relating to the ear

explanation.surface: A vivid English newspaper is caught up in a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hearing' suggests a court case; here it means the sense of hearing, hence the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Exotic things are striking and unusual, often vividly coloured, as with tropical birds.

clue.text: Part of city starts to slag off Home Office

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letter of each of the two words that follow

parts.note: taken as written, the source of two initial letters

explanation.surface: Someone begins to rubbish the government department in charge of policing.
explanation.walkthrough: To slag off is British slang for to criticise harshly.
explanation.definitionFit: Soho is a district of central London known for nightlife and media firms.

clue.text: Horrible old chest holding new debtor's notes

indicators.note: holding means the chest word contains the new letter

parts.note: a box is a chest
IOUs are written acknowledgements of debt

explanation.surface: A dreadful old trunk stuffed with fresh IOUs.
explanation.definitionFit: Obnoxious means extremely unpleasant or offensive.

clue.text: Outstanding male feature's very soft in water

indicators.note: in tells us the soft marking is placed inside the water phrase

parts.note: Adam's ale is a jocular name for water, the only drink in Eden
pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very soft

explanation.surface: A man boasts that his best physical feature is very soft in the bath.
explanation.definitionFit: The Adam's apple is the throat projection that stands out more prominently in men.

clue.text: Fit one wool supplier up, touring classy island

indicators.note: touring means going around, so the reversed letters enclose the classy letter
in a down answer up means the letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: to suit is to fit
a ram is a male sheep
U means upper-class, acceptable to the smart set

explanation.surface: A smart island tour gets one wool producer fitted out.
explanation.definitionFit: Mauritius is an island nation in the Indian Ocean.

clue.text: Soppy book about island on line

indicators.note: about means the book word is turned round

parts.note: a tome is a large book
Iona is an island in the Scottish Inner Hebrides

explanation.surface: A sentimental book about an island, written line by line.
explanation.definitionFit: Soppy means sentimental, given to tearful feeling.

clue.text: County charity's first to go broke

parts.note: Down is a county of Northern Ireland

indicators.note: first to go means the gift word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a handout is a charitable gift

explanation.surface: A county charity's founder departs and the organisation goes bankrupt.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone down-and-out is destitute, with no money or home.

clue.text: Source of crude painting in good health

parts.note: an oil is a painting in oils
well means healthy

explanation.surface: A rough painting looks healthy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crude' suggests coarse work; here it is crude oil.
explanation.definitionFit: An oil well is a bored shaft from which petroleum is extracted.

clue.text: Perfect state of Irish victor housed by granny

indicators.note: housed by means the Irish and victor letters sit inside the granny word

parts.note: nana is a child's word for grandmother
V is the letter's code word in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: Grandma puts up an Irish winner in her home.
explanation.definitionFit: Nirvana is the Buddhist state of perfect bliss and release.

clue.text: Gambling centre where pound note's gone west

indicators.note: in an across answer going west means reading right to left

parts.note: a oner is slang for a one-pound note

explanation.surface: A town where a gambler's last pound note has vanished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gone west' also means lost or dead, which suits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Reno in Nevada is a well-known casino city.

clue.text: Staged revolutionary Hamlet, say, and suchlike inside

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the combined letters run backwards
inside means the suchlike abbreviation goes within the Dane word

parts.note: Hamlet is the Prince of Denmark, so a Dane
etc, et cetera, means and so on

explanation.surface: A radical production of Hamlet and similar plays was put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Enacted means performed or acted out on stage.

clue.text: Want costly article reduced

parts.note: dear means expensive

indicators.note: reduced means the article loses its final letter

parts.note: the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Shoppers want a pricey item marked down.
explanation.definitionFit: A dearth is a lack or scarcity, as want means need or shortage.

clue.text: English sides swallowing one team's panacea

indicators.note: swallowing means the side letters enclose the number and team letters

parts.note: left and right are the two sides
a cricket or football team is an eleven, XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: English teams gulp down a single squad's cure-all.
explanation.definitionFit: An elixir is a supposed remedy for all ills, a magic cure.

clue.text: Scholars of 50 briefly repeating themselves? Not on!

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

indicators.note: Not tells us the word on is removed from the repetition word

parts.note: iteration is the act of repeating
taken as written

explanation.surface: Academics in their fifties, nagged for repeating themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: The literati are learned, literary people, the intelligentsia.

clue.text: Green militant with energy to bully a bishop downing port

parts.note: to cow is to intimidate
taken as written

indicators.note: downing here means swallowing, so the bishop letters take in the port

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: An environmental activist intimidates a bishop who is knocking back port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Downing port' suggests drinking the wine; here the port is a city, consumed by the bishop abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: An eco-warrior is a radical environmental campaigner, green in the political sense.

clue.text: Brown belt strains here and there

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the colour, light brown
second meaning: to tan someone's hide is to thrash them

indicators.note: here and there means only scattered letters, every other one, are taken

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A martial artist's brown belt shows strain in places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brown belt' looks like a judo grade; it is two separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Tan is a yellowish-brown colour and also a verb for beating, as in tanning a hide.

clue.text: Pressure monk to preserve small part of vessel's contents

indicators.note: to preserve means the monk word keeps the small letter safe inside

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist monk

explanation.surface: A monk is pressed into preserving a fragment of a ship's cargo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessel' suggests a ship; it is a blood vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Plasma is the fluid part of the blood, carried through the veins and arteries.

clue.text: A carrier on building site cuts short time in plant

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: cuts means the carrier goes into the shortened time word
short means the time word loses its last letter

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
a hod is a trough for carrying bricks

explanation.surface: A hod carrier on site trims his hours to work in a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The asphodel is a lily-family flower, famed in myth from the Elysian fields.
